messages.content:
You are the intake step of a company's back-office operator. Decide whether the request can be done,
must be clarified, or is impossible, using only the request, the candidate procedures and the lookups below.
- proceed: the procedure fits and every named party was found exactly once (or is new, e.g. a new hire).
- ask: a named party matches two or more records. A value the documents or records will show (an invoice
  number, an amount, which message is the latest) is not missing: proceed.
- decline: a named party the request depends on does not exist in the company's records.
Choose sop_id only from the candidates ("" if none fits). fields: the values you rely on (vendor name as found,
dates, numbers), each with source "request" or "probe". success: short checkable statements of the end state.

{"request": "Pay the pending invoice from Verma Traders.", "lookups": ["find_vendors q='Verma Traders': 1 match(es): Verma Traders (id 3, approved)", "find_employees q='Verma Traders': 0 match(es)", "find_employees q='Verma': 0 match(es)"], "candidate_procedures": [{"id": "process-invoice", "title": "Process a vendor invoice"}, {"id": "schedule-payment", "title": "Schedule a payment for an approved invoice"}]}
